source_caption_text:
2 Chainz really is a national treasure mann, we gotta protect him at all costs 🙏🏾

2 Chainz, born Tauheed Epps in College Park, Georgia, is an American rapper, songwriter, media personality, and entrepreneur. Before launching his massive solo career, he initially gained widespread recognition under the moniker Tity Boi as one half of the Southern hip-hop duo Playaz Circle, alongside Dolla Boy. The group achieved commercial success under Ludacris’s Disturbing tha Peace label with their 2007 smash hit “Duffle Bag Boy” featuring Lil Wayne.

In the early 2010s, he rebranded to 2 Chainz to create a more mainstream-friendly image and embarked on a solo trajectory that quickly skyrocketed. His 2012 debut solo album, *Based on a T.R.U. Story*, debuted at number one on the Billboard 200, propelled by hit singles like “No Lie” featuring Drake and “Birthday Song” featuring Kanye West. Known for his clever punchlines, distinct southern drawl, and energetic charisma, 2 Chainz became one of hip-hop’s most requested feature artists, winning a Grammy Award for his guest appearance on Chance the Rapper’s track “No Problem”. Beyond music, he has expanded his brand as an actor and host, notably starring in the popular Viceland series *Most Expensivest*, while also managing various business ventures and sports team ownerships.
